cost: Per generation neighbors O(sum list lengths+D*K+bytes); history sorting O(D log D * J) journal scans, external score/bootstrap costs, result sort O(D log D), selection O(D). No speed claim; requested threads are uncapped.
description: Neighbor proposals and adoption with explicit effect boundary
forward: Build defaults into base, score base dev/validation, enumerate neighbors, order by positive journal history then delta label, reuse or score each result, sort by dev gain/index, and optionally adopt a positive-dev/nonnegative-validation/p<0.05 result for at most gens iterations. Nonadopt stops after first generation. run(domains) may persist hot config.

run loads files and builds Component; tune joins neighboring_configs with history sorting before assigning indices, then selected index back to deltas. Only pure seams execute in tests. Journal/scoring/IO orchestration remains source-inspected.
inverse: Universe: successful finite orchestration traces under callback, IO and arithmetic premises. Exclude more than gens adoptions, adopting dev<=0/validation<0/p>=0.05 or NaN, changing two map keys per proposal, and adoption with adopt=false. Do not exclude journal writes without adoption or side-effectful callbacks.

Final base cannot identify trial count, journal hits, callbacks, initial state or rejected alternatives. Zero generations/nonadoption returns defaults for many traces. Chosen tuple cannot recover scores, bootstrap samples or configuration without deltas.
limitations: Finite supplied inputs; no live parser, teacher, corpus, journal-backed tune or GPU.
Partial syntax; macros opaque and semantic AST absent.
Unvalidated numeric/resource domains and effect boundaries remain explicit in scoped models.
state: Original public signatures remain; pure seams do not mutate inputs. Selection equivalence assumes unique candidate indices, true in production. Score-vector alignment, i64 representability, callback safety and IO success are unvalidated premises.
